title: Microsoft recasts Copilot as the operating system for work
summary: Satya Nadella opened Ignite in San Francisco by describing Copilot as "the new operating system for work". Word, Excel and PowerPoint are now generally available inside Copilot, alongside shared Workspaces, a Code surface and an Autopilot agent that runs tasks continuously; billing for Autopilot will use Copilot Credits, with pricing still unannounced. Microsoft also published Code 2 and Cyber 2 models, brought GPT-6.2 and Meta's latest models into Foundry, and said 50 million agents are managed through Agent 365.
